_note: Curated timed-entry / vehicle-reservation requirements, keyed by entity id. Dates + booking URLs are best-effort for the 2026 season and SHOULD get a human verification pass each spring. Read by build-parks.js; additive to parks-enriched.json.

nps:acad.name: Cadillac Summit Road vehicle reservation
nps:acad.summary: A vehicle reservation is required to drive Cadillac Summit Road from late May through mid-October. Reservations open on Recreation.gov up to 90 days ahead, with a batch of next-day reservations released at 10 a.m. the day before. No reservation is needed to enter the rest of Acadia.

nps:romo.name: Timed-entry permit
nps:romo.summary: Rocky Mountain National Park uses a timed-entry permit system in peak season (roughly late May through mid-October). Two permit types are sold on Recreation.gov: one covering the Bear Lake Road corridor and one for the rest of the park. Permits are released the month prior, with next-day permits at 7 p.m. A permit is not required outside the timed-entry window or before 5 a.m. / after 6 p.m.

nps:hale.name: Haleakalā sunrise reservation
nps:hale.summary: Entering the summit area of Haleakalā between 3 a.m. and 7 a.m. for sunrise requires a reservation, booked on Recreation.gov up to 60 days ahead (a small number release 48 hours prior). No reservation is needed to visit the summit after 7 a.m. or the Kīpahulu (coastal) District.

nps:shen.name: Old Rag day-use ticket
nps:shen.summary: Hiking the Old Rag area (including Ridge, Saddle, and Weakley Hollow fire roads) requires a day-use ticket from March 1 through November 30 — 400 per day, sold on Recreation.gov 30 days ahead plus a next-day batch. The rest of Shenandoah and Skyline Drive need no reservation.

nps:cave.name: Timed-entry reservation
nps:cave.summary: Entry to the Carlsbad Cavern (via the Natural Entrance or elevator) requires a timed-entry reservation, booked on Recreation.gov. Reservations are released in a rolling window; some same-day slots are held back. Ranger-guided tours are booked separately.
